title: The Big Bang
blurb: Sixty decades of time on one slider, from the Planck era to now — and a shaded region marking exactly where the evidence runs out.

sources.cite: Cyburt et al. 2016, Rev. Mod. Phys. 88, 015004
Guth 1981, PRD 23, 347; Linde 1982, Phys. Lett. B 108, 389

open: Epoch times and temperatures are interpolated log-log between published markers rather than integrated from the Friedmann equations.
Everything before ~1e-12 s is extrapolation beyond collider-tested energies. The module labels this explicitly.
Inflation is shown because it is standard, but it is inferred, not confirmed.
